Brilliant presentation on how "AI evolved over the time"

A short video chronicling the development of artificial intelligence, from “Attention is all you need” to #AGI, was produced utilizing Opus 5.5. The three-minute project was created solely through code, without stock footage or AI-generated images.

All frames were rendered programmatically using approximately 7,400 lines of #React and #TypeScript via Remotion. Visuals were drawn in SVG and Canvas, narration was provided through open-source text-to-speech, and the soundtrack was synthesized in #Python. Completion required around one hour and accounted for 7% of a weekly workload.
